info.title: iPass → Pharos | Employee Access API
info.description:
Employee-centric ingestion from iPass to Pharos. No authentication or automatic database setup is configured.

| Event | Required data | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| USER_PROVISIONED | Full employee, account and approved iPassRoles | Add access or explicitly restore a terminated employee. |
| USER_UPDATED | Full employee, account and complete current iPassRoles | Update profile and replace assignments for that account only. |
| USER_TERMINATED | employeeId and TERMINATED status | Disable employment and close all account assignments in this deployment. |

Account identity is application + environment + oktaAccountId. Role identity is application + environment + entitlementValue. Internal database-generated UUID keys are never sent by iPass.

New event: new UUID. Identical retry: same UUID and unchanged payload. No eventVersion; iPass must preserve employee event order. Employee identity must stay stable across source systems and rehire.

Compose initializes the database from ddl/01_create_schema.sql. After schema edits, recreate the development volume with docker compose down -v followed by docker compose up -d. Example IDs and data are fictional.

tags.name: Employee access
tags.description: One employee and one environment per request.

post.summary: Send employee details and current Pharos roles
post.description:
Send one employee/account snapshot for one environment. Only approved, effective Pharos roles belong in iPassRoles.

- Include all employee fields, account, manager and iPassRoles for provisioning/updates. Middle names may be null; terminationDate must be null while ACTIVE.
- Account IDs and entitlement values are scoped by application and environment. An existing account cannot be reassigned to another employee.
- Omitted roles are revoked from the specified account only. Missing/null iPassRoles is invalid; [] removes all account assignments.
- Owners are shared role metadata. Send their complete list; [] clears it. Removing an assignment never removes a role or its owners.
- Flags are JSON booleans. Requestability and privilege flags do not grant or revoke access by themselves.
- Changing a known entitlement's roleName requires review and returns 409.
- Termination needs only employeeId and TERMINATED status, plus terminationDate when known. It closes assignments for every linked account in this deployment, regardless of the 15-day iPass cleanup. Optional role/profile content does not restore access.
- Approved USER_PROVISIONED is required after termination. Only assignments explicitly supplied for that account are restored.
- New event: new UUID. Identical retry: same UUID and payload. Retry failures with the same event; use a new UUID for corrected content. Source deliveries must stay in order.

requestBody.description: Complete employee/account snapshot, or minimal termination details. Select a scenario below.

200.description: Saved successfully. An identical retry returns the same acknowledgement without repeating changes.

400.description: Missing field, wrong field type, or invalid JSON. Correct the request.

409.description: Event UUID reused with different content, account linked to another employee, conflicting entitlement name, or disallowed reactivation.

422.description: Invalid field combination, repeated role ID, wrong role environment, or future assignment. Correct the request.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait as instructed by Retry-After, then retry the same event.

503.description: Service temporarily unavailable. Retry the same event with a delay.

500.description: Server error. Retry the same event with a delay.

middleName.description: Manager middle name; null if none.

employeeClass.description: Source employee class, retained separately from employmentType.

eventId.description: The same UUID received in the request. PostgreSQL: UUID.

employee.description: Stored employee profile using database column names.

assignments.description: Current assignments by default; includeHistory=true also returns removed assignments. assignmentStatus and removedAt distinguish current and removed assignments.

oktaAccountId.description: Opaque source account ID. May differ across environments.

Account.description: Account whose complete role list is supplied.

ownerId.description: Source owner identifier; the owner need not have a Pharos account.

RoleOwner.description: Owner of the shared role, not the employee receiving it.

entitlementValue.description: Source role identifier, scoped to application and environment.

entitlementType.description: Source entitlement category, for example groups.

isAvailableForRequest.description: Requestability metadata. False does not revoke an existing assignment.

isPrivileged.description: Role metadata under the agreed payload shape; does not grant permissions. Confirm its source meaning with iPass.

owners.description: Complete current owner list for the role. [] clears owners. Missing/null is invalid. ownerId must be unique within the list.

assignedAt.description: Original assignment time for this account; unchanged while the assignment continues.

assignmentStatus.description: PROVISIONED only. Removed roles are omitted from the account snapshot.

IPassRole.description: One current approved Pharos entitlement. Shared role metadata and account assignment are stored separately.

CorrelationId.description: Pharos-generated UUID for this HTTP request. Quote it when troubleshooting. Retries receive a new correlation ID; eventId remains unchanged.
